paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Yosi of Mechoza.
Mentioned in the Zohar, Noach 63b; he lived in the village of Dramin.[^1]

notes.text: סג: gives Zohar Noach 63b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification; it is not a literal English sg: rendering. Dramin transliterates דראמין without a new geographic identification. The residence subject is understood as the heading figure. The abbreviated title remains R'.
